items: Launched on 22 January 2015, under the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign, SSY is a
government-backed savings scheme that encourages parents to save for their girl child's future,
specifically for higher education and marriage.
 Account Opening: By parent/guardian in a bank or post office.
 Deposit: Minimum Rs. 250, Maximum Rs. 1.5 lakh/year.
 Maturity: Account matures after 21 years, with partial withdrawals (up to 50%) for education
 Interest: High interest rate (usually higher than regular savings accounts), tax-free returns under
Section 10(11) of the Income Tax Act.
 Duration: 15 years of deposit, with maturity at 21 years.
This scheme ensures financial security for the girl child’s future education and marriage.
